item.title: Version 0.6.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • RevenueCat reconnect no longer lands on an empty “No iOS apps to map yet” screen when your apps came from Apple Ads campaigns or the sidebar hadn’t finished loading.
  • Previous RevenueCat project mappings are restored automatically on reconnect. If every app re-binds cleanly the dialog dismisses itself with a confirmation toast — no manual review pass.
  • Deleted RevenueCat projects are flagged with a “pick another” prompt instead of silently dropped.

Changed

  • Reconnect flow polish: skips the sign-in pitch when you’re already signed in, narrates progress step-by-step, marks each row as restored or auto-matched, and Cancel now offers Save / Discard / Keep editing.
